title: Petition of John G. Crowe Associates, Inc. requesting an exemption from the casing requirements of Rule IV of D.P.U. 12729, for 5 proposed roadway crossings of the Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company's Gas transmission pipeline located to the south side of Boston Post Road, (Route 20) adjacent to Hager Pond in Marlborough, Massachusetts, with driveway and parking pavement for the Raytheon project.
